about: The Pit's legends as Region 1 characters (Dom 2026-10-22: Dungeon 1 is the Gladiator Pit, its creatures are the Pit ladder's own legends). One rule row: the id prefix, the progression row and loot table a legend pays, and the character TEMPLATE every legend is made from. origins/region1/legend-foes.ts maps the legend tables (src/fight/legend-rows.json + legend-families.json) over the template: {id} {name} {source} {backstory} {opponent} {rank} are filled from the legend and its family (a value that is exactly one placeholder keeps the placeholder's type, so {rank} is a number). Nothing about a single legend is written here.
